meta.title: 男生拍照姿势——【站、坐、走】入门级教学✨
meta.title_en: Men's Photo Poses: Beginner Guide for Standing, Sitting & Walking

scenes.title_cn: 站姿：为什么我的评论区这么多男生要学…
scenes.title_en: Standing: why do so many guys in my commen…
scenes.context: 站姿：插袋+伸腿+点地+挑肩。
sentences: 把你的手插进口袋，接着伸出一条腿，脚插点地。
Slip your hand in your pocket, extend a leg, point the toe into the ground.
再挑起一点点你的肩膀。
Then lift your shoulder just a little.
scenes.speak: Slip your hand in your pocket, extend a leg, point the toe into the ground. Then lift your shoulder just a little.

scenes.title_cn: 饮品+坐姿：爱喝饮料吗？拿着。不要整…
scenes.title_en: Drink + sitting: like drinks? Hold it—but …
scenes.context: 拿饮料用捏取+坐姿开腿并脚。
sentences: 不要整个拿着，而是要用纸缚拿，再把手肘抬起来一些。
Don't grip the whole cup—pinch it and raise your elbow.
把腿分开，但脚要并拢，然后一只手撑脸，一只手搭腿。
Spread the legs, keep feet together, one hand on cheek, one on leg.
scenes.speak: Don't grip the whole cup—pinch it and raise your elbow. Spread the legs, keep feet together, one hand on cheek, one on leg.

scenes.title_cn: 走路姿势：好了走吧。诶，不是让你真走…
scenes.title_en: Walking: okay, walk. Hey, not really—I mea…
scenes.context: 走路：重心居中前后踱步+手部动作。
sentences: 把重心放在两腿中间，前后来回地走。
Put the weight between your legs and pace back and forth.
Pocket, collar, scratch the head—for men.
scenes.speak: Put the weight between your legs and pace back and forth. Pocket, collar, scratch the head—for men.

practice: Hand in pocket, one leg out, toe pointing.
Lift one shoulder just a little.
Pinch the cup, not the whole hand, raise the elbow.
Spread legs, feet together, one hand on cheek.
Weight centered, pace back and forth.
pitfalls: Face the lens rigidly with arms down.
Relax, pocket the hand, extend a leg.
Grip the cup with the whole hand.
Pinch it and raise the elbow.
Spread the legs but keep the feet together.
Pretend to walk, pacing in place.
Use pocket, collar, and head-scratch moves.
shifts: 用 beginner guide（入门教学）、standing/sitting/walking（站坐走）
用 pocket（插兜）、pinched hold（捏取）、elbow up（抬肘）
用 toe pointing（脚点地）、lift a shoulder（挑肩）、feet together（脚并拢）
